subtasks.title: Implement _resolve_label_id with lazy cache and no-re-fetch invariant
details: async def _resolve_label_id(self, label_name: str) -> int.
If label_name in self._label_cache: return self._label_cache[label_name].
If self._cache_populated (full fetch already done): raise IntegrationError(f'Label {label_name!r} not found in repo').
Otherwise: GET {self.base_url}/repos/{self.owner}/{self.repo}/labels; raise IntegrationError(resp.text[:500]) on non-2xx.
Populate self._label_cache with all {item['name']: item['id']} pairs; set self._cache_populated = True.
Return self._label_cache[label_name] or raise IntegrationError if still absent.

subtasks.title: Implement create_pr with 409 duplicate detection
details: async def create_pr(self, title, body, head, base) -> str.
POST {base_url}/repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls with {'title':title,'body':body,'head':head,'base':base}.
If 2xx: return data['html_url'].
If 409: GET {base_url}/repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls with params head=head, base=base, state='open'; raise IntegrationError(resp.text[:500]) on non-2xx GET.
If GET returns empty list: raise IntegrationError('409 duplicate returned but no existing open PR found for head={head} base={base}').
Otherwise return existing_prs[0]['html_url'].
For any other non-2xx POST status: raise IntegrationError(resp.text[:500]).
